question: What do you call organisms made of more than one cell?
solution:
The correct answer is __**multicellular.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Multicellular organisms** are made up of **more than one cell** and are **complex** in structure compared to **unicellular organisms.**
 
• Multicellular organisms have **specialized cells** that perform **specific functions** and work together to maintain the** organism's survival.**
 
• Examples of multicellular organisms include **plants, animals, and fungi.**
 
• **Subcellular **refers to structures or processes that occur within a **single cell**, while **paracellular** refers to the** movement of substances** between cells.
 
• **Unicellular organisms** are made up of a** single cell **and can carry out all necessary functions for survival within that cell.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subcellular:** Examples of subcellular structures include organelles such as the **nucleus, mitochondria, and ribosomes.**
 
• **Paracellular:** This movement can occur through gaps between **adjacent cells or through specialized protein **channels that span the cell membrane.
 
• **Unicellular:** Examples of unicellular organisms include **bacteria and protists.**
